subtitle: Verified progress from the active subscription setup run
viewPurpose: Replay sanitized setup evidence and follow resource discovery and final verification. This screen cannot start, retry, approve, or alter provisioning.
done: Infrastructure deployment completed. Readiness verification continues.
ready: Subscription setup is verified and ready.
readinessDescription: Each gate is independently observed. Deployment completion alone cannot mark the run ready.
inventoryEstimate: Counts are estimates until the active generation and coverage manifest pass independent readback.
